about: Every asset the game ships, and where it comes from. Kept true by tests/config/assets.test.ts: a file in src/assets or public that is not listed here fails the build, and so does a listed path that does not exist. Read with docs/ASSETS.md.

assets.what: Fredoka, variable, Latin subset: headings, buttons, island names
assets.madeWith: Bundled unmodified by Vite from src/styles/fonts.css

assets.what: Nunito, variable, Latin subset: running text
assets.madeWith: Bundled unmodified by Vite from src/styles/fonts.css

assets.what: Brand mark, seven world emblems, six player pictures
assets.madeWith: Hand-written SVG

assets.what: Installable-app icons
assets.madeWith: Rendered from the brand mark by scripts/generate-icons.mjs (npm run icons)

assets.what: Interface icons on a 24-unit grid
assets.madeWith: Hand-written SVG

assets.what: Glim, the guide: one rigged drawing with six states; and the character sheet
assets.madeWith: Hand-written SVG, posed and moved with CSS

assets.what: Number Garden: apple, leaf, snail, acorn, bird, mouse, frog, and the friends things are given to; towers of blocks, frames of five and ten, numbered stones, stories of things that come and go, and a bell
assets.madeWith: Hand-written SVG

assets.what: The picture kit: 68 plain drawings of things (a sun, a sock, a hen), 15 drawn lower-case letters (sh, ch and th are drawn from them, two to a tile) and the numerals 0 to 9
assets.madeWith: Hand-written SVG

assets.what: Each world's own drawings: Reading Cove's sound cards and word tiles, its claps, its line of print and its pictures of one thing on or in another (put together from the picture kit); Memory Forest's scenes; Robot Ridge's robot and ground; Inventor Island's bridge, ramp, beam and tub; Explorer Harbor's 37 story pictures, its maps, flags, islands and boat, its globe (drawn from the atlas's outlines) and its fifteen famous places; the Music Lab's chime bars, bird, drum and signs
assets.madeWith: Hand-written SVG. Explorer Harbor's maps are drawn from numbers written by its content generator, and its globe from the outlines in the atlas (listed below); the fifteen famous places are drawn by hand, from no photograph and no other drawing

assets.what: The shapes every island is sculpted from, and what floats between the islands
assets.madeWith: Written in code on three.js geometry; no model files

assets.what: Academy Rock and the six world islands
assets.madeWith: Sculpted in code with the modelling kit

assets.what: The brush texture and the painted material
assets.madeWith: Generated on the device from seeded noise (128 × 128, three channels); no image file

assets.what: The water: shallows, foam, rings, shadows, glints
assets.madeWith: GLSL written for this project

assets.what: The islands, boats, rock and cloud as pictures: what the hub shows first and falls back to
assets.madeWith: Rendered from the island models by scripts/render-sprites.mjs (npm run art:sprites); encoded as WebP

assets.what: The picture's sea: a gradient matched to the 3D water, and a tile of wave marks
assets.madeWith: CSS, with a small SVG written inline

assets.what: Eleven interface sounds, and the Music Lab's instruments: chime bars, a pipe, a drum and a click
assets.madeWith: Synthesised on the device with the Web Audio API, each from two or three oscillators; no audio files, no samples and no recordings, so there is no source audio to license

assets.what: The voice: one short recording for every line a child hears, for single words, and for six sounds that are not speech (a drum, a bell, a shaker, a whistle, a bird, a clock)
assets.madeWith: Synthesised ahead of time by scripts/voice/make_voice.py with piper-tts 1.8.0 (a GPL-3.0 tool, used to make the files and not shipped) and the voice model en_US-kristin-medium from rhasspy/piper-voices (repository licence MIT; its model card says it was trained on public-domain LibriVox recordings). A word said in its beats is that word cut where the synthesiser says its sounds are, with a breath put between (which needs the onnx package, Apache-2.0, also a tool and not shipped); where each beat, each sound of a slow word and each word of a sentence read aloud begins is written down the same way, in src/voice/marks. The six sounds are made by the same script from a few lines of arithmetic each. Encoded as MP3 by ffmpeg. Each spoken clip was checked by a speech recogniser (faster-whisper, small.en); src/voice/manifest.json records the result and whether a person has listened to it. No person has

assets.what: The content packs: every activity's challenges, written out in full, one file for each world; the storybook they draw on; and the list of the seven continents and fifteen famous places for the globe, with where each is
assets.madeWith: Written for this project: by hand, and from tables by the generators in scripts/content (npm run content). Where each famous place is was written down by hand and then compared with the coordinates on its Wikipedia article (scripts/atlas/check_places.mjs); only numbers were compared, and nothing was copied

assets.what: The outlines of the seven continents, for Explorer Harbor's globe: 2117 points in 122 outlines, with no country and no border among them
assets.source: Natural Earth, Admin 0 – Countries, 1:110m: ne_110m_admin_0_countries.geojson from the natural-earth-vector repository (sha256 6866c877d39cba9c357620878839b336d569f8c662d3cfab4cb1dbe2d39c977f)
assets.holder: None: Natural Earth's map data is in the public domain
assets.madeWith: scripts/atlas/make_atlas.mjs: countries melted into continents, Russia divided at 60 degrees east, outlines made coarser. Not the source file: what is shipped is what the script wrote

assets.what: Web manifest, robots.txt, the note in public/assets
assets.madeWith: Written for this project
